title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for persistent joint pain and stiffness.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting today for an evaluation of chronic pain in his bilateral knees and hips. He reports that the stiffness is most pronounced in the morning and after periods of prolonged inactivity. He describes a dull, aching sensation that occasionally sharpens during strenuous activity. He has tried over-the-counter NSAIDs with limited relief. He denies any recent falls, new swelling, or systemic fevers. He notes that his mobility is slightly impaired but he remains independent with his daily activities.

Medication List
Sacubitril-valsartan 49/97 mg, carvedilol 12.5 mg, furosemide 40 mg, spironolactone 25 mg.

Exam
The patient appears in no acute distress. He is alert and oriented x3. Physical exam reveals mild tenderness to palpation over the bilateral patellae and hips. Range of motion is preserved but limited by discomfort. No erythema or warmth is noted over the joints. Gait is steady.

Assessment
1. Chronic joint pain and stiffness.
2. Stable clinical status regarding current medications.

Plan
The patient will begin a course of physical therapy to improve range of motion and strengthen supporting musculature. We will also discuss a topical lidocaine patch for localized symptomatic relief. He will follow up in four weeks to assess progress with physical therapy.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, PA-C
May 14, 2026
explanations: Heart-failure medications on the list do not establish the diagnosis; coders do not infer diagnoses from medications.

distractors.why: Only the provider can document a diagnosis.
